status: FROZEN — every gate constant set BEFORE the qualifier goes live. Any change is a NEW pre-registration with its own forward series.
mandate: SENTINEL is a QUALIFICATION layer, not an arming layer. It suppresses (no email) unless ALL Part-1 gates pass. It NEVER changes the engine's setup detection; it decides whether a detected setup is allowed to reach the lock screen. DESCRIPTIVE until n>=30. SIMULATED / advisory — not financial advice.
why: 30d of sent alerts (~201 fires, ~6-7/day) were mostly noise: 0-for-6 ascending Cluster-Fade shorts into a one-way grind on 8/3; ~1/3 fired outside the tradeable window; the washout leg was 4-of-7 opening-rotation TRIN spikes. The fix is qualification gates, a washout retune, a lock-screen format, and a forward scorecard so this is never email archaeology again.

gate1_window.note: kills the 9:30/9:32/9:38 pre-classification fires and the 7/28 15:46 after-flat-rule fire

gate2_slope_v3_1.method: least-squares slope over a 30-min / 30-row window on ADD, VOLD, TRIN (1-min rows)
gate2_slope_v3_1.flat_test: abs(slope * (n_rows-1)) must be >= flat_frac * level, where level = abs(mean(series)); else FLAT => fail
gate2_slope_v3_1.note: 8/3 fails here all session: VOLD rising + TRIN falling => the SHORT OR-clause is false

gate3_divergence_floor.note: the 8/3 11:26 fire cited ADD 1155->1140 (delta 15) — floor 150 kills it as micro-noise

gate4_event_completion.cluster_fade: pool must be TAGGED and price must REJECT — re-cross back through the level within 3x 1-min bars
gate4_event_completion.failed_retest: a 15m boundary close >= 1pt beyond the boundary, THEN the retest of it
gate4_event_completion.no_approaching: no 'approaching'/'testing' fires — the event must have COMPLETED

gate5_risk_floor.stop_rule: stop >= 1.5 * ATR(5m) beyond the invalidating extreme

gate6_debounce.rule: one alert per (setup, level +/- 3pts) per SESSION
gate6_debounce.note: the 7618 double-fire (11:05 & 13:21, identical level) must be impossible

gate7_daily_cap.after_taken_trade: suppress the rest of the session (honors 'one loss = done')

part2_washout_retune.reason: opening rotation noise — 4 of 7 washout fires were TRIN spikes within 2 min of the bell
washout_requires_all: price AT a named support level
reclaim of that level within 3x 1-min bars
part2_washout_retune.note: only 7/29 TICK=-920 was a real washout under this rule

part4_scorecard.logs: every fire AND every suppressed near-miss
part4_scorecard.outcome: triple-barrier via nightly labeler (T1/T2/stop, else time-barrier)
part4_scorecard.publish: sentinel_scorecard.json to the dashboard: n_fired, n_qualified, win%, expectancy, by setup and by day-type
